data.name: Luigi
data.gender_notes: Luigi is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Italian 'Ludovico', Luigi means 'little warrior'. In Christian tradition, it is also the name of a popular saint, Saint Luigi Gonzaga. He was a nobleman and a member of the Society of Jesus who is known for his devotion to his parents, particularly his mother. The name Luigi carries the meaning “Little warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Luigi usually hope their child will grow to embody little warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Luigi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luigi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Luigi is a popular name in Italy and is widely used among the Italian-American community. It is also the name of a beloved character in video games, Luigi from the Super Mario series. His gentle demeanor but brave persona has touched the hearts of many and is a reminder that even the smallest and seemingly most insignificant among us can be mighty.
data.spiritual_significance: As a name associated with Saint Luigi Gonzaga, Luigi holds a deep spiritual significance. He is a model of devotion to one's family, particularly to one's parents. His life serves as a reminder of the importance of loving and taking care of our loved ones. Additionally, Luigi's journey as a member of the Society of Jesus can inspire us to become men and women for others, living our lives in service to God and to the people around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: When God looked upon Luigi, He saw the light of the lamb shining brightly in his heart. May God grant him the strength and courage to carry His love into the world. Symbolically, the name Luigi represents the shining light of God's love within an individual, inspiring them to carry that love into the world with strength and courage.

historical_references.reference: Luigi Gonzaga, a renowned Italian poet and nobleman in the late 16th century, was born in Mantua, Italy, in 1561. He was a member of the powerful and influential Gonzaga family, who ruled the Duchy of Mantua during that period. Luigi's poems were characterized by their deep religious sentiment and were widely admired throughout Europe. He was also known for his chivalric exploits and his dedication to the Catholic Church.

Luigi Galvani, an Italian physiologist of the 18th century, is best known for his discovery of 'animal electricity' in the 1760s. He made this discovery by observing the contraction of a frog's leg muscle when it was touched with a metal rod and a nerve was stimulated. Galvani's experiments laid the groundwork for the study of electrophysiology, which is the branch of biology that deals with the electrical properties of cells and organs.

modern_usage.modern_context: Luigi, the Italian-born brother of Mario, is a beloved character in the video game industry. He's known for his green overalls and distinctive hat, and has assumed various roles over the years as a sidekick or even a superhero in his own right. Three popular modern platforms where Luigi is featured include Nintendo's Super Mario Bros. series, Microsoft's Forza Horizon series, and Sony's Luigi's Mansion series.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named John Luigi in London, United Kingdom credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Luigi, which means "Little warrior". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
